scope: Eighth original local playable direction: a real Three.js/WebGL three-dimensional scene viewed through a chase-camera perspective, connected to transport, trading and exploration choices. Flight and mission rules operate on the x/z navigation plane. Loaded ship/station models, spherical textured planets, scene lights and a perspective camera provide real spatial depth; the nebula texture is the scene environment background. Asteroids are decorative and do not participate in collisions. The sample has no six-degree-of-freedom motion or combat. The gameplay and interface are original; five meshes are CC0 Kenney Space Kit assets and the three opaque environment/surface bitmaps are original ImageGen assets. Recorded rule, controller, real-browser and final resource delivery checks pass within their explicit scope; no upstream Endless Sky code or art port is claimed.
sample: 星潮航路 / Star Tide Routes

checks.name: Real flight, missions and resource accounting
checks.observed: 27 production rules and 25 actual controller callback checks pass. Ordinary and manually repeated commands navigate continuously, deliver reserved cargo, trade free cargo with ledger-accounted credits/profit, sustain a five-second scan and return for settlement. Inertia, docking distance/speed, fuel/refuel, explicit delayed rescue, pauses and validated independent restores are covered. The prior seven directions have 230 passed recorded checks.

checks.name: Actual three-dimensional production rendering
checks.observed: 7 accepted real WebGL JPEG captures show loaded ship/station GLBs, textured spherical planets, lighting and chase/sector camera views. The final native paused-flight frame was visually reviewed: ship, stations, planet, target labels and readable in-stage HUD remain visible. Nebula is the environment background; x/z-plane rules remain separate from the 3D presentation. No Skia frame is used as 3D evidence.

checks.name: Browser input and responsive layout
checks.observed: 11 actual derived browser assertions pass: manual transport/trade/scan/return and ordinary demo finish at 730 credits and 40 trade profit; moving-ship takeover, native C/E/Space, pause, reload restoration, native fullscreen HUD/target synchronization/exit, desktop and 390x844 responsive CSS layout, final stage alignment and empty warn/error log are recorded. Physical held-key timing, rescue and context-loss recovery are covered by controller callbacks, not claimed as hardware/browser tests.

checks.name: Final delivery and asset provenance
checks.observed: 789 package checks pass and 27 actual resources match source, public build and live HTTP bytes. Three opaque ImageGen PNGs are 1774x887, with full prompts/source paths in the actual assets manifest; five complete CC0 GLBs retain the license/source notice. The package imports actual JavaScript declarations while excluding comments, strings, templates and regex text.
